[[USMM Hadjout]] |league topscorer = [[Hocine Achiou]] (12 goals) |biggest home win = |biggest away win = |highest scoring = |matches = |total goals = |longest wins = |longest unbeaten = |longest losses = |highest attendance = |lowest attendance = |average attendance = |prevseason = [[2012–13 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 2|2012–13]] |nextseason = [[2014–15 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 2|2014–15]] }} The '''2013–14 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 2''' was the forty-eight edition of the Algerian second division since its establishment, and its fourth season of the league under its current title. A total of 16 teams contested the league. The league started August 23, 2013, and concluded on May 16, 2014. [[USM Bel-Abbès]] were crowned champions and promoted to the [[2014–15 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 1]] along with [[NA Hussein Dey]] and [[ASM Oran]]. At the bottom of the table, [[A Bou Saâda]], [[US Chaouia]] and [[USMM Hadjout]] were relegated. ==Changes from last season== ===From Ligue Professionnelle 2=== '''Promoted to [[2013–14 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 1|Ligue 1]]''' * [[CRB Aïn Fakroun]] * [[RC Arbaâ]] * [[MO Béjaïa]] '''Relegated to [[2013–14 Ligue Nationale du Football Amateur|Championnat National]]''' * [[MO Constantine]] * [[SA Mohammadia]] * [[CR Témouchent]] ===To Ligue Professionnelle 2=== '''Relegated from [[2012–13 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 1|Ligue 1]]''' * [[CA Batna]] * [[WA Tlemcen]] * [[USM Bel-Abbès]] '''Promoted from [[2012-13 Ligue Nationale du Football Amateur|Championnat National]]''' * [[A Bou Saâda]] * [[US Chaouia]] * [[USMM Hadjout]] ==Team overview== ===Stadia and locations=== {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
